svg.text: LangGraph SUPERVISOR (30 routes) + RAG + patterns + opt-in layers (hexagonal ports)
3 — 30 supervisor routes: 15 core MEMBERS + 15 opt-in (each node returns control to the supervisor)
+ 15 opt-in routes (registered only when their settings flag is on)
patterns: tot_agent · debate_agent · constitutional_filter · lats_agent · llm_compiler · mixture_agent
pipelines: customer_service · document_generation · data_etl · code_review · debate_consensus
helpers, not routes: meta_learner · skill_creator · network_supervisor · spawner
6 — RAG (11 engines) + VectorStorePort (hexagonal port; default Chroma)
7 — Opt-in layers (settings; flag off = byte-for-byte identical graph)
wave 2026-10 (3.13 – 3.19) — each behind its own master flag; shadow mode first where applicable
Layer 7 detail — A2A (Agent2Agent): bidirectional interop, opt-in [a2a], complements MCP (tools <-> agents)
Trust boundary: all remote content -> L1 InputSanitizer + audited (hash, no content) · tenant/principal mismatch => TaskNotFound
